name: Knight of Xoroth: Sacrificial Circle client row drops the Hellfire Imp caster aura (#7607)
contract: Raw Sacrificial Circle 805677 requires caster aura 805916 (Hellfire Imp) in Spell.dbc; the server clears it (#1489) and checks the caster's own living imps instead. The client evaluates CasterAuraSpell against its own Spell.dbc, so the client's own 805677 row must carry with numeric field 24 (CasterAuraSpell) equal to 0 and field 26 (ExcludeCasterAuraSpell) equal to 0. Runeshroud 500639 is the control proving the client rows are read. This verifies the client's spell data; client rendering and input remain outside the native harness.

steps.label: CONTROL: the client's Runeshroud row 500639 is read
The client has a Sacrificial Circle row
Sacrificial Circle no longer requires the Hellfire Imp caster aura on the client
Sacrificial Circle carries no excluded caster aura on the client
